Livermore's budget over time

Ten years of what the city's governmental funds took in and spent, as its annual financial report states them, and the four printed columns of the current budget's revenue, each column a sum of rows the city printed.

  • a kind, coloured by its size in the last column and the same colour in every column
  • a kind whose rows sum below zero in a column, hung below the baseline
